title: Working with John Casimir and Wooden Joe
summary: He worked in Casimir's orchestra, and mentions recording with Wooden Joe.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: Now you work with John Kazimer?
I work with Kazimer in orchestra. In the orchestra? In the orchestra, not in the brass band. I work in the brass band.
Did you work with him when Wooden Joe used to be with him? Wooden Joe Nicholas? Wooden Joe, you remember Joe? Yes, I made some records with him.
He used to play right over here in Los Angeles.
